## Decks

- **grey**: 10 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell).
- **blood-price**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell).
- **elementalist**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell).
- **blood-price+half**: 20 cards; dead-card rate 0% (mean share of the deck never played in a cell).
- **elementalist~20of30**: 16 draws of 20 distinct cards from a 30-card pool (elementalist); mean dead-card rate 0% (every draw is in `history.jsonl`).
- **mixed~20of60**: 16 draws of 20 distinct cards from a 60-card pool (blood-price + elementalist); mean dead-card rate 0% (every draw is in `history.jsonl`).
